Direct message the job poster from HCLTech

20+ years of professional experience in SAP, enterprise software, or digital transformation roles.

SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Business Applications

Prior experience in SAP, SAP partners, or large global system integrators.
Experience shaping or leading AI Centers of Excellence (CoE) .
Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) as they integrate with SAP.
Exposure to AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks.
Thought leadership through speaking engagements, publications, or industry forums.
Industries IT Services and IT Consulting and Software Development
